title: CoverageRequest
description:
Searched tracks and host-measured effort against a probability map. See
`docs/design/sar-planning.md` 2.6.

defaultPod.description:
Per-pass detection probability of tracks that set none (default 0.8,
a hasty search along a path: a starting value, not calibrated).

efforts.description:
Up to 256 efforts the host measured itself (a video coverage grid, a
scored sweep), 1,000,000 cells or edges in all. Each is a search of its
own: an edge's misses over tracks and efforts multiply.

segments.description: Segments to report coverage for (ids unique); may be empty.

tracks.description: Up to 256 tracks (with `efforts`, at least one of the two).

CellEffort.description:
One grid cell's detection: row 0 is the grid's south row, column 0 its
west column.

oneOf.description:
The probability the search would have detected the person there, in
[0, 1].

Seconds the place was seen (a camera's dwell time), at least 0: the
probability of detection is `1 - exp(-seenS / tauS)` with the
effort's `tau_s`.

EdgeEffort.description:
One edge's detection (`edgeId`: either directed id, or the undirected
key).

oneOf.description:
The probability the search would have detected the person there, in
[0, 1].

Seconds the place was seen (a camera's dwell time), at least 0: the
probability of detection is `1 - exp(-seenS / tauS)` with the
effort's `tau_s`.

EdgeProbability.description: One edge's probability of holding the person.

avoidOnly.description: Reached only by crossing an `avoid` zone (or inside one).

edgeId.description: The undirected key (the smaller directed id of the edge's two).

timeS.description:
The model time at which the edge is first entered (the complying
search's when it reaches the edge).

oneOf.description:
Per edge, as a host that already knows the network's edges scores
them.

A grid of equal cells in degrees from `southWest`, listing only the
cells that were searched (the rest count as not searched). An edge
takes the length-weighted mean of the cells along its shape: the
chance of detecting a person anywhere on it.

One detection over a whole area (a sweep the team scored): every edge
inside the polygon takes it.

The probability the search would have detected the person there, in
[0, 1].

Seconds the place was seen (a camera's dwell time), at least 0: the
probability of detection is `1 - exp(-seenS / tauS)` with the
effort's `tau_s`.

A road vehicle (car, van, truck), costed close to driving time.
Private and destination-only roads only at a route's ends.

A tracked or off-road vehicle on the vehicle network: tracks are
strongly preferred, and speeds are capped (30 km/h on tracks, 42 km/h
on main roads). Private and destination-only roads only at a route's
ends.

An emergency vehicle: the roads cars may use and busways, and not
confined to through roads (it may cross private and destination-only
roads).

A person walking, costed close to walking time (about 5 km/h), as
Valhalla's pedestrian costing: footways, paths and streets alike.

Travel on foot that keeps to tracks and paths: the ways `OnFoot` may
use, and bikeable ways `foot=no` closes to it (a cycleway with
`foot=no`, a track with `access=no, bicycle=yes`). Tracks and paths cost
half as much as streets, main roads are avoided more strongly, and the
pace on tracks and paths is faster (6–6.5 km/h).

ProbabilityMap.description:
Probability of area on the network: per edge, plus what lies beyond.
Edges, `unlisted`, `rest_of_world` and `off_network` add up to 1.

edges.description: Sorted by edge key; only edges above 0.

offNetwork.description:
Mass of bands or rings with no reachable path in them (the network
ended: the person went off the network or stopped at its end).

restOfWorld.description:
Beyond the outermost band (faster than nearly everyone, or outside the
distance rings).

unlisted.description:
Mass of reached edges left out of `edges` by the request's `maxEdges`
or `minEdgeProbability`: on the network, but not on any listed edge.

SearchEffort.description:
Search effort the host measured: a source (a drone, a camera, a team's
own sweep) and where and how well it searched. Efforts and tracks are
independent searches: an edge's misses multiply.

sourceId.description: Who or what searched, for the report.

tauS.description:
Seconds of viewing that detect with probability `1 - 1/e` (about
63 %): the time constant of `Detection::SeenS`. Needed when any of the
effort's detections is in seconds.

SearchSegment.description:
A search segment: an area one team searches in one assignment, as people
drew it. It is taken as given: any winding, convex or not, never split,
merged or clipped to the reach; overlapping segments each count the paths
inside them, and a segment with no path inside still gets arrival times
(to its access point, off the paths with `offTrail`).

accessPoint.description:
Where a team enters the segment; by default a point inside the
polygon (its centroid when that is inside).

probability.description:
The segment's probability of area when the planner sets it; by
default the sum of the plan's edge probabilities inside the polygon.

TeamTrack.description: One team's GPS track of a search assignment.

pod.description:
The probability one pass along a path detects the person on it, in
[0, 1]; by default the request's `default_pod`.
